contractCaps.note: Caps by size (50K/100K/150K) count all open contracts, with 10 micros = 1 mini, so any mix fits. Product caps are from Topstep's Risk Adjustments page, updated 16 Nov 2026 (https://help.topstep.com/en/articles/13613539-risk-adjustments-high-risk-high-volatility). Micro Bitcoin (MBT): 5/10/15. Temporary high-volatility caps, in force on 16 Nov 2026: CL, QM, RB and HO 3/6/9; MCL 30/60/90; GC 3/6/9; MGC 30/60/90; SIL and MHG 2/5/7; SI, HG and PL 0 (cannot be traded). Topstep says these last only while volatility is high. Micro Ether (MET): Topstep caps it at mini-equivalent sizes but gives no number, so the app blocks it (0) until that is confirmed. Products Topstep doesn't permit are 0: full-size BTC and ETH, EMD, QO, QI, PA, KE, ZO, ZR, GF, ZQ and the ICE softs. Old calculator (v4): MBT 50/100/150, and 5/10/15 on the energies and metals above.

fees.note: Topstep's total round-turn cost per contract on TopstepX (open and close), in US dollars: exchange fee, NFA fee and Topstep's commission. Topstep says these apply to the Trading Combine, Express Funded and Live Funded accounts.

notModelled: Maximum Loss Limit (trails the end-of-day balance) and the optional Daily Loss Limit: not set up, so loss limits are not checked.
Profit target and the 55% consistency target.
Be flat by 3:10 PM Chicago time every weekday; avoid opening trades after 3:08 PM.
Tier 1 news (CPI, NFP, PPI, FOMC): from 5 minutes before to 5 minutes after, no new ES, NQ, RTY, YM, NKD, GC, SI, HG or PL trades, and micros are capped lower.
Don't hold a position within 2% of a product's CME price limit.
Trading your full maximum size into scheduled major news is not allowed.
Express Funded Account (XFA): caps follow the Scaling Plan by balance and start low (a new 50K starts at 2 lots). Not set up in the app.
Live Funded Account: micros count as full contracts. Not set up in the app.
Topstep Labs accounts have their own caps (for example the $50K Static Combine: 4 minis or 40 micros, 4 MBT). Not set up in the app.
